ivy-marketing: Quick last-minute ask for rehearsal tomorrow AM: can runtime run a tiny 'starlight' probe to validate coldstart consistency across three payload sizes? Need artifacts by 08:15 PT.

Specs: 36 requests (12 short/12 med/12 long), models: redwood-lite-7b fp16 and lite-7b-q4 fallback. Baseline without KV cache plus one cached comparison. Deliverables: latencies.csv (include seq_len), percentile summary, coldstart heatmap PNG, sampled traces for p95+, and one logits snapshot for any long-case p99. Keep wall time <20m.

noah-runtime: We can do it. Two clarifications: (1) include node tag in CSV? (2) traces sampled as you requested?

ivy-marketing: Yes node tag please. Sample traces for p95+ and first cold request per node.

ben-platform: Note: shared pool maintenance 03:30-04:30 PT. Recommend slot 06:20 PT to avoid noisy window.

noah-runtime: Scheduling baseline 06:20 PT (run_id=st-2765432150) and cached run 06:55 PT. Concurrency capped at 3. Outputs: latencies.csv, percentiles.png, heatmap.png, traces.tgz, logits_snapshot.npy.gz.

bench-bot: Job queued st-2765432150 (est 13m).

ops-bot: st-2765432150 completed. Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood.internal/runs/st-2765432150/starlight_probe.tar.gz

ivy-marketing: Downloaded. One long-case p99 spike at req-031. Please surface trace and logits and a short note.

noah-runtime: Included traces/req-031.json and snapshots/logits-req-031.npy.gz. Quick note: p99 spike coincided with a transient scheduler jitter on host gpu-dedicated-12 during first-token assembly; not model-related. Re-run on gpu-dedicated-13 did not reproduce.

ben-platform: We'll flag gpu-dedicated-12 for follow-up and recommend reserving gpu-dedicated-13 for rehearsal.

ivy-marketing: Can you paste a 3-bullet pasteable summary for rehearsal notes?

noah-runtime: Posted summary: "Starlight probe (n=36 across short/med/long) on redwood-lite-7b (fp16) with lite-7b-q4 fallback. Artifacts: per-request latencies (with seq_len & node), percentile plots, coldstart heatmap, sampled traces (p95+), and logits snapshot for long-case p99. Observed isolated p99 tied to host scheduler jitter on gpu-dedicated-12; not reproduced on gpu-dedicated-13. Recommendation: reserve gpu-dedicated-13 for rehearsal and monitor overnight."

ivy-marketing: Perfect 3a5 Thanks everyone ":) Closing thread. "
